panels.title: Zrodla
panels.description: To samo, co panel diagnostyczny dodatku, ale z historia przebiegow. AUTH_LOCKED wymaga recznego odblokowania (§10.2).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT source_key AS "zrodlo", enabled AS "wlaczone",
       auth_state AS "logowanie",
       aktywne_aukcje AS "aktywnych",
       last_run_started_at AS "ostatni przebieg",
       last_run_new AS "nowych",
       last_run_changed AS "zmienionych",
       last_run_errors AS "bledow",
       last_run_rss_bytes AS "RSS"
FROM reporting.v_source_health
ORDER BY source_key
